# AgentHub (llms.txt)

> The unified remote continuation & control plane for official AI agent runtimes (Claude Code, OpenAI Codex & ACP).

## Summary
AgentHub bridges local terminal AI coding agents (Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, ACP agents) to remote web browsers and mobile devices without reinventing an inference loop. A single-binary Rust daemon (`agenthub-runner`) embeds a local web console (`http://127.0.0.1:4200`) and connects via outbound-only TLS/WebSockets to a self-hosted Gateway, enabling live output streaming, diff-backed permission approvals, multi-turn continuation, and emergency stops from any browser or mobile PWA without opening inbound ports.

## Quick Start
1. Local embedded console: `agenthub-runner web` (`http://127.0.0.1:4200`) or `agenthub-runner daemon`
2. Self-hosted Gateway + Web:
   - `npm ci`
   - `npm start --workspace @agent-pulse/api` (Gateway on `:3001`)
   - `npm run dev --workspace @agent-pulse/web` (Web UI on `:3000`)

## Key Technical Facts
- Version: 2.5.2 | License: MIT (Copyright 2026 WANGUI TANG) | Repo: https://github.com/xiaoran7/agenthub
- Pure Rust 2024 runner (`agenthub-runner`) with embedded zero-dependency Web Console, per-request usage ledger, and federated Skill/MCP/Hook library.
- Outbound-only TLS/WSS: zero public inbound ports on workstation; local paths redacted to `ws-*` workspace IDs; provider credentials never leave the host.
- Native `create`, `resume`, and read-only `discover` semantics with single-writer session ownership and durable command idempotency (`client_cmd_id`).
- Full specification: `llms-full.txt` and `docs/README.md`.
